summary: Regression + new feature test for: (1) MongoDB env-var priority fix in lib/mongodb.ts, (2) qr.ts hardcoded URL removal, (3) lockfile conflict fix, (4) NEW homepage Digital<->Physical loop showcase in HomeHowItWorks.tsx. NEW homepage section (data-testid=digital-physical-loop) verified present with loop-digital-card, loop-connector, loop-physical-card all rendering actual images (naturalWidth=240, not broken), visually coherent with dark cosmic violet/gold theme, responsive on both 1920x1000 desktop and 390x844 mobile viewports. Fixed 2 stale backend test failures caused by rotated admin credentials (test file hardcoded old admin/gachard123 instead of reading current .env values) - not a functional bug, just an outdated test fixture.

No regressions detected from the mongodb.ts env-var priority swap or qr.ts fallback URL removal in this preview environment (DB was already connected here); fix is production-targeted per problem statement and cannot be verified against production from this environment.
